description: Returns the EU and national provisions in the regulation register for the chosen country, optionally only those linked to one pattern, each with what it requires in plain words, the article, the date checked and a link to the official text.

country.description: Country: SI, AT, DE or HR

lang.description: Language of the result: sl, en, de or hr. Texts not yet translated are returned in English and marked in the result.

pattern_id.description: Only provisions linked to this pattern

name: adoption_get_regulations
title: Get regulations for a country and pattern
